# opnsense_bind_status (Data Source)

Reads the current BIND service status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_bind_status" "main" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) BIND service status such as `running`, `stopped`, or `disabled`.
